425431.overview:
Star Wars is an unlicensed game based on the original Star Wars movie. The game is played from the viewpoint of a spaceship with a viewfinder in the center of the screen. The objective of the game is to position the enemy spaceship fully within the viewfinder and then a hit is automatically registered. Meanwhile the second player has to attempt to steer the ship off the screen. If he succeeds the roles are reversed and he will begin chasing the other player.

There are three game modes: one player, two players and an advanced one player game where the computer opponent automatically scores after escaping and the player remains the chaser. For each game modes there are three different speed levels.

Press 'Clear' and then select game '1' (1 player) or '2' (2 player) or '3' (Advanced player) on Keypad A
Select speed '1' (slow) or '2' (medium) or '3' (fast) on Keypad A
Runner Keypad controls are '2' (up'), '8' (down), '4' (left), '6' (right)
Chaser Keypad controls are '2' (down'), '8' (up), '4' (right), '6' (left)
Spaceship and viewfinder of A is red, B is yellow
